children.text: Now that I am in junior high school, my life has changed a lot compared with my primary school days.
children.cn: 既然我已经上了初中，与小学时光相比，我的生活发生了很大的变化。
children.notes: now that: 既然；compared with: 与……相比
children.statement: now that 引导的是原因状语从句，意思是‘既然’。
children.explanation: now that 表示‘既然’，用来引出已知的前提或原因。

children.text: In the past, my primary school was near my home, so I used to walk to school.
children.cn: 过去，我的小学离家很近，所以我常常步行上学。
children.notes: used to walk: 过去常常步行
children.statement: used to do 表示过去常常做某事，而现在不再这样。
children.explanation: used to + 动词原形表示过去的习惯动作。
children.keywords: in the past, near, used to walk
children.highlight: In the past, so, used to

children.text: Now my new school is farther, and I take a bus with my friends every day.
children.cn: 现在我的新学校更远了，我每天和朋友们一起乘公共汽车。
children.statement: farther 是 far 的最高级形式。
children.explanation: farther 是 far 的比较级，最高级是 farthest。

children.text: My family has also moved into a larger apartment, and my grandma lives with us now.
children.cn: 我们家也搬进了一套更大的公寓，现在奶奶和我们住在一起。
children.notes: has moved into: 已经搬进（现在完成时）
children.statement: has moved into 使用的是现在完成时态。
children.explanation: has + 过去分词 moved 构成现在完成时。

children.text: Although many things have changed over time, the love and warmth in my family will always remain the same.
children.cn: 尽管随着时间的流逝许多事情发生了变化，但我家中的爱与温暖将永远保持不变。
children.notes: remain the same: 保持不变
children.statement: remain the same 意思是‘变得不同’。
children.explanation: remain the same 表示‘保持相同 / 保持不变’。
children.keywords: changed, love, warmth, remain the same

children.text: Now that I am in junior high school, my life has changed a lot compared with my primary school days.
children.cn: 既然我已经上了初中，与小学时光相比，我的生活发生了很大的变化。
children.statement: 该句作为文章的论点引入句。
children.explanation: 该句点明了文章的主题——生活中的变化。

children.text: To begin with, my daily routine has been completely transformed because my school is located much farther away.
children.cn: 首先，我的日常生活被彻底改变了，因为我的学校坐落在更远的地方。
children.notes: to begin with: 首先；be completely transformed: 被彻底改变
children.statement: to begin with 是常用的行文衔接词，表示‘首先’。
children.explanation: to begin with 用于列举要点的第一项。

children.text: Instead of walking to school as I used to, I now commute by bus with my classmates every morning.
children.cn: 我不再像过去那样步行去学校，而是每天早晨和同学们一起乘公共汽车通勤。
children.notes: instead of: 而不是；commute: 通勤
children.statement: instead of 后面通常接名词或动名词短语。
children.explanation: instead of 介词短语后接 walking 动名词。

children.text: Furthermore, my family has moved into a spacious flat where my grandmother has her own room.
children.cn: 此外，我们全家搬进了一套宽敞的公寓，在那里我祖母有了她自己的房间。
children.notes: furthermore: 此外；spacious: 宽敞的；where 引导定语从句
children.statement: where 在句中引导定语从句，修饰先行词 flat。
children.explanation: where 作为关系副词，在定语从句中充当地点状语。

children.text: In terms of study, I have become much more confident through active participation in collaborative group projects.
children.cn: 在学习方面，通过积极参与合作小组项目，我变得自信多了。
children.notes: in terms of: 在……方面；collaborative: 合作的
children.explanation: collaborative 表示‘合作的、协作的’。

children.text: In conclusion, no matter how drastically external circumstances evolve, the deep affection and support within my family will endure forever.
children.cn: 总而言之，无论外界环境发生多么剧烈的变化，我家中的深厚亲情与支持都将永恒延续。
children.notes: in conclusion: 总之；no matter how: 无论多么；endure: 持久/延续
children.statement: endure 在句中表示‘延续、持久’。
children.explanation: endure 表达长久存在、历久不衰。
children.keywords: in conclusion, affection, support, endure forever
